integrity: The classification is proved symbolically from the two exact outside-neighbor equations. Exhaustive subset enumeration for n from three through eight independently checks every accepted set, coefficient, classification type, and connectivity consequence; the finite computation is not used as the infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to connected crown graphs with n at least three and to the standard outside-vertex definition of perfect domination. The 2013 edge-perturbation paper was only partially readable through the available route, leaving a specific residual literature risk for a differently phrased two-part consequence.
title: Perfect dominating sets of crown graphs
